title: APU vs SPU: tuition, size, location
summary: Azusa Pacific University (APU) versus Seattle Pacific University (SPU). Also searched as SPU vs APU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) and Azusa Pacific University (APU) are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes reported by College Scorecard. SPU is located in Seattle, while APU is situated in Azusa. The undergraduate enrollment at SPU is 1,762 students, compared to 2,759 students at APU. Tuition for in-state students at SPU is $40,407, whereas at APU it is slightly higher, at $44,458.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing Seattle Pacific University (SPU) and Azusa Pacific University (APU), the cost of tuition is a notable difference. SPU charges $40,407 for both in-state and out-of-state tuition, while APU's tuition is higher at $44,458 for both categories. Regarding student debt, the median amount owed by graduates who completed their programs at SPU is $24,000. In contrast, APU graduates have a slightly lower median debt of $23,219. These figures provide insight into the financial commitments associated with attending each institution.

sections.heading: Accreditation
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) and Azusa Pacific University (APU) are both accredited institutions, ensuring that they meet established standards of quality in higher education. Accreditation is a key factor for students considering these universities, as it affects credit transferability, eligibility for federal financial aid, and recognition of degrees. While specific accrediting bodies are not detailed here, both SPU and APU maintain accreditation status that supports their academic programs and institutional operations.

sections.heading: Pick SPU if
paragraphs: Pick Seattle Pacific University (SPU) if you prefer a private nonprofit institution with an admission rate of approximately 83.4%.
